# T-2: Route conflict lifecycle

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Integrate scoped metadata persistence into the normal finalize-merge error lifecycle while retaining retry state and side-effect contracts.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Failure evidence is persisted before the rebase instruction reaches the user.
- Retry restores downstream pending states and completes merge/outbox effects once.
- Normal and direct-finalize paths retain their documented behavior.

## Implementation Notes
Coordinate merge command classification with definition and registry lifecycle ownership; do not create a parallel direct-finalize state machine.

## Test Strategy
Shared lifecycle tests cover R2, R4, and R5 retry and normal-path behavior.
